mapper.insert: insert into item_message (item_id, sender_id, receiver_id, parent_id, content, is_read) values (#{itemId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{parentId}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: select seller_id from item where id = #{itemId}
select m.*, u.nickname as senderNickname from item_message m left join `user` u on m.sender_id = u.id where m.item_id = #{itemId} order by m.created_at asc
mapper.update: update item_message set is_read = 1 where id = #{id} and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
update item_message set is_read = 1 where item_id = #{itemId} and receiver_id = #{receiverId}
